# check_oauth_request_match_code()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.check_oauth_request_match_code`

## Signature

```python
async def check_oauth_request_match_code(url: str, match_code: str) -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Check the code chosen by the user for an OAuth authorization request.

Only usable when [`OauthLinkInfo`](../../types/authorization/OauthLinkInfo.md) has *match_code_first* set. If the check fails, the
authorization request has failed. Otherwise, show the authorization confirmation dialog and process the
request with [`accept_oauth_request`](accept_oauth_request.md) (passing the same code) or
[`decline_oauth_request`](decline_oauth_request.md).

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`url`** (`str`)
  The OAuth deep link, as returned in *url* of [`OauthLinkInfo`](../../types/authorization/OauthLinkInfo.md).

- **`match_code`** (`str`)
  The code chosen by the user among [`OauthLinkInfo`](../../types/authorization/OauthLinkInfo.md) *match_codes*.

### Returns

`bool`: True, if the code matches the one shown on the login page.

### Example

```python
if await app.check_oauth_request_match_code(link, info.match_codes[0]):
    print("The code is correct")
```
